test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
What is the mean of the following distribution?

 
 

 Marks
 14 
 26 
 44 
 61 
 84 
 
 
 
 

 No. of Students
 91
 78
 95
 36
 98
solution:
**Given:**

Marks = [14, 26, 44, 61, 84]

No. of Students = [91, 78, 95, 36, 98]

**Formula used:**

Mean = (Σ(Marks × Frequency)) / (Σ(Frequency))

**Calculations:**

Calculate Σ(Marks × Frequency)

14 × 91 = 1274

26 × 78 = 2028

44 × 95 = 4180

61 × 36 = 2196

84 × 98 = 8232

⇒ Σ(Marks × Frequency) = 1274 + 2028 + 4180 + 2196 + 8232 = 17910

Calculate Σ(Frequency)

91 + 78 + 95 + 36 + 98 = 398

Mean = Σ(Marks × Frequency) / Σ(Frequency)

⇒ Mean = 17910 / 398

⇒ Mean = 45

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
